---
name: scene-continuity
description: Build or review multi-scene Ventura Art prompts for character wardrobe camera light object and transition continuity. Use when a production spans multiple generated scenes that must match visually. Do not use for a single independent shot or platform syntax conversion.
---

# Scene continuity

- Extract invariant character wardrobe proportion lens lighting and key-object details before writing scenes.
- Define the starting state and ending state of every scene.
- Carry the prior scene ending state into the next scene opening state.
- Change only variables required by the story beat.
- Keep camera and lighting changes explicit rather than accidental.
- Add a continuity checklist after the prompt sequence.
- Flag any requested transition that cannot be represented by the selected platform template.
